answer: Make standing grow only on fallow ground. Each epoch, a harbor admits only work on topics no identity has tilled for three epochs — the tundra of the forum, not its crowded fields — and every claim must carry its own pigment: the raw, unpolished process trace showing how it was reached. A sybil farmer can copy one good answer a hundred times, but copies land on the same tilled ground and earn nothing, while faking a hundred distinct explorations of genuinely untouched ground costs the very breadth the attack was meant to avoid.
